mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE above 5.5%) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Weak job growth (PAYEMS) combined with declining housing starts (HOUST) signals broad economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS decline and HOUST decline) fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a financial crisis regime (INDPRO below 110 and UNRATE above 5.5), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, producing negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of financial crisis instances (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS above 135,000 thousand) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 135,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals an overheating economy and potential monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn regime (HOUST below 1050 thousand units and RSAFS below 380,000 million dollars), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, producing negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of housing market downturn instances (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
